title: BaFin Circular 07/2024: Margin Requirements for Non-Centrally Cleared FX Forwards
summary: Updated variation margin exchange requirements for non-centrally cleared FX derivatives.
full text: Counterparties to non-centrally cleared FX forward and swap transactions exceeding the relevant threshold must exchange variation margin on a daily basis, calculated using an approved standardised methodology. (Reference: EMIR REFIT Art. 4.)
dos: Exchange variation margin daily using an approved standardised methodology.
Notify BaFin and ESMA promptly when nearing clearing obligation thresholds.
Reconcile trade repository reports on a daily basis.
donts: Do not omit sub-threshold FX forwards from daily margin calculations where in scope.
Avoid exceeding clearing thresholds without prior notification to BaFin and ESMA.
Do not leave reporting breaks exceeding 5 business days unremediated.

title: BaFin Circular 16/2024: Conflicts of Interest Disclosure in Principal Trading
summary: Enhanced disclosure obligations when firms trade as principal against client flow.
full text: Where a firm executes client orders on a principal basis, it must disclose the conflict of interest in writing prior to execution and maintain records demonstrating that pricing was not disadvantageous to the client. (Reference: WpHG §85.)
dos: Disclose material conflicts of interest in internal crossing arrangements.
Document a specific execution strategy for each illiquid bond order.
Aggregate execution quality metrics across all connected venues quarterly.
donts: Do not bundle research payments with execution commissions.
Avoid principal trading against client flow without prior written disclosure.
Avoid internalizing client order flow without documented best-execution justification.

title: BaFin Circular 10/2024: Segregation of Duties for Proprietary Trading Desks
summary: Reinforced segregation-of-duties requirements between front office and risk control functions.
full text: Institutions operating proprietary trading desks must ensure strict segregation of duties between trade execution, risk measurement, and P&L validation functions, with no dual-hatting permitted at desk-head level. (Reference: KWG §10.)
dos: Complete annual fit-and-proper reassessments for desk head roles.
Conduct quarterly stress tests on high-frequency trading strategies.
Maintain strict segregation between execution, risk, and P&L validation roles.
donts: Do not permit dual-hatting between execution and risk control functions.
Avoid disabling circuit breakers without Head of Trading approval.

title: BaFin Circular 17/2024: Inducements and Research Unbundling Compliance
summary: Continued enforcement of research payment unbundling requirements for equity research.
full text: Firms must ensure that payments for investment research are separated from execution commissions, with research budgets approved and reviewed by Compliance on an annual basis. (Reference: WpHG §83.)
dos: Separate research payments from execution commissions at all times.
Disclose material conflicts of interest in internal crossing arrangements.
Aggregate execution quality metrics across all connected venues quarterly.
donts: Avoid internalizing client order flow without documented best-execution justification.
Do not bundle research payments with execution commissions.
